source_documents.title: Aggregation-induced emission and polymorphism/shape/size-dependent emission behaviours of fenamates for potential drug evaluation

reference_evidence_units.quote: This phenomenon also exists in MFA and FFA, indicating the presence of AIE activities
reference_evidence_units.subject: FFA with fenamate comparators
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Ethanol/water anti-solvent crystallization; FFA SI Figs. S22-S24 cited in main.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors report AIE for FFA as well as MFA; detailed water-series plots shown in main are TFA, not FFA.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; TFA 50% onset must not transfer to FFA.

reference_evidence_units.quote: FFA I and FFA III emit blue light (λem = 438 nm) and cyan light (λem = 458 nm), respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: FFA polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 365 nm excitation; main text and Table 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: FFA I and III emit at 438 and 458 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Different polymorphs, not two emissions assigned to one solution species.

reference_evidence_units.subject: FFA polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1, integrating sphere; visually checked column alignment.
reference_evidence_units.statement: FFA I/III have reported QY values 58.7/10.3 and lifetimes 4.39/0.58, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Table omits explicit QY-percent and lifetime units; preserve printed values without silently inventing units. MFA and TFA columns not transferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the polymorphism-dependent emission behaviour of FFA is also ascribed to the similar phenomenon of conjugation.
reference_evidence_units.subject: FFA polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Conformer orbital plots and published crystal structures, Fig. 3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign redder FFA III emission to greater coplanarity/conjugation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not an explicit ICT/TICT or radiative-rate result; no new calculations performed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: which obviously limits the rotation and vibration of molecules
reference_evidence_units.subject: fenamate hydrogen-bonded dimers including FFA
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 3 dimer comparison; stronger MFA I bond contrasted with broadly similar bonds in FFA I/III.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors invoke dimer hydrogen bonds limiting molecular rotation/vibration; this is a series-level enabling interpretation, not an FFA-specific dynamic test.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Discussion particularly addresses MFA compensation; source typo O-H...H is not treated as verified hydrogen-bond atom assignment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The crystals of FFA III with totally different shapes and sizes were detected almost the same UV-Vis diffuse reflectance spectra and PL spectra
reference_evidence_units.subject: FFA III shape/size control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 4k-o small needles versus large flakes, visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: FFA III spectra remain nearly unchanged with shape/size, unlike TFA and MFA controls.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Does not exclude every possible morphology effect; SI facet spectra not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In this way, FFA I in ethanol−water mixtures with different water fractions were obtained.
reference_evidence_units.subject: FFA I preparation
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 7.0 mg in ethanol; add water to total 4 mL, room temperature.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Source provides a separate FFA I water-fraction preparation, distinguished from FFA III prepared using a warm concentrated stock.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Preparation identity is source-reported; PXRD verification is in missing SI.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain explicit series-level dimer restriction interpretation with limited target specificity; not proven FFA torsional kinetics.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Polymorph-dependent molecular conformation and hydrogen-bond organization, not generic size dependence, govern source interpretation.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain explicit series-level dimer restriction interpretation with limited target specificity; not proven FFA torsional kinetics.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Polymorph-dependent molecular conformation and hydrogen-bond organization, not generic size dependence, govern source interpretation.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target host-guest binding mechanism is established; ordinary solvent polarity is not host inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer excited-state assignment is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer photophysics is established. Ground-state protonation or hydrogen bonding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex assignment is established; aggregation or close packing alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism is established beyond the other pathways; intensity and lifetime alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer pathway is established; metal binding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection access mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or suppression of Kasha's rule is established.
